body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. If the target is wounded, ignore 1 Defense.

surges.html: Gain +1 Defense against the primary target until the start of your next turn.
On a success, the target cannot voluntarily move more than 2 units before its next turn ends.

rider.title: FINISHER
rider.html: After rolling, you may spend 2 Combo. If you do and the Action succeeds, knock the target Prone after dealing damage.
